candidates.statement: Payment authorization calls from order time out (ReadTimeout, transport error) after ~2s, causing order and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502. Traces show payment POST failing while inventory/redis succeed, and checkout p95 ~2425ms with 16 502s/min.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side latency metrics/logs not admitted; root cause within payment service unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show payment /v1/authorizations ReadTimeout transport errors propagating to order and gateway 502s, while inventory/redis calls succeed. Metrics confirm checkout 502s and elevated p95 latency. Bounded to downstream payment latency; deeper payment-side cause needs more evidence.
